name: checkStore

versions.rationale: Seed implementation from the plan (Metadata schema and storage); small enough to build and test on day one.
Also validates notes: schema, id matches filename, anchors and check files exist, supersession is valid, and warns when an anchored unit has changed since the note was confirmed.

docs:
Validates the whole store: config, lock, every unit file and every note
against their JSON Schemas, then the rules a schema cannot express (ids
match filenames, version chains are intact, references point at real units,
notes and files, and notes are flagged when their units have moved on).
